plugin.name: Plugin_Manager
plugin.author: Crowley
plugin.purpose: Install, update, reload, enable, disable and remove plugins from one place
plugin.description: Plugin Manager pm open or close the manager window pm list [crowley|stock|other|store|links|updates|all] list plugins as text (numbers work in every command) pm check [crowley|other|store|all|NAME|NUMBER] read the sources and mark plugins that have a newer version or a changed file. No word: every source. A tab name checks only what that tab comes from; a plugin checks just its own source. Stock plugins are never checked (the AardMUSHclient package updates them). In the window: tick plugins or repositories and press Check selected, or press Check all for the tab you are on. Adding a repository reads only that repository pm force NAME|NUMBER replace an installed plugin with a look-alike offered by a repository (a fork): backs up the current one, takes it out, installs the repository's pm update NAME|NUMBER|all download the newer version, keep the old file as a backup, reload it pm install NAME|NUMBER download a plugin that is offered but not loaded, and load it pm reload|unload|enable|disable NAME|NUMBER pm add [FILE] add a plugin file you downloaded yourself (no FILE: pick one); it is copied in and loaded pm load FILE load a plugin file where it is (a path, or a file name inside the plugins folder) pm remove NAME|NUMBER uninstall a plugin from MUSHclient (nothing is deleted: its file and its saved data stay) pm rollback NAME|NUMBER put back the file the last update replaced pm info NAME|NUMBER details, file, source, repository link pm open NAME|NUMBER open the repository link in your browser pm aliases NAME|NUMBER a window with the aliases the plugin defines (pm triggers: its triggers); Copy puts the list on the clipboard pm state NAME|NUMBER open the plugin's saved-state file in your editor (the program your system uses to edit .xml files) pm source list the places plugins are offered from pm source add URL add a GitHub repository (https://github.com/OWNER/REPO), a manifest (.json) or a plugin file (.xml). A GitHub user or organization (https://github.com/NAME) opens a checklist of its repositories pm source scan URL for a GitHub user or organization: look through its repositories and add the ones that contain plugins pm source remove N|URL|OWNER stop listing a source, or every source of an owner (plugins already installed stay) pm font [NAME [SIZE]|reset] show or change the window font pm save save the world file, so what is loaded now is loaded next time pm manifest [URL|reset] show or set the address of the main manifest (https only) pm dir [FOLDER] show or set the folder new plugins are installed into pm auto on|off read the main manifest about once a day and say when there are updates (never installs anything; repositories are checked by hand) pm help this list NAME can be part of a name. Nothing is ever installed or updated without a command or a button click.

local SELF = GetPluginID() local WIN = "PluginManagerWin"
local function say(msg) ColourNote("silver", "", "[Plugins] ", "white", "", msg) end local function var(name, default) local v = GetVariable(name); if v == nil or v == "" then return default end; return v end local function trim(s) return (tostring(s or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")) end local function rc_text(rc) return (error_desc and error_desc[rc]) or ("error " .. tostring(rc)) end
local H = {} -- small helpers (kept in a table: a Lua chunk may only have 200 local variables) local json_ok, json = pcall(require, "json") local async_ok, async = pcall(require, "async")
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Files and paths --------------------------------------------------------------------------- local function basename(p) return (tostring(p):match("([^\\/]*)$")) end local function dirname(p) return (tostring(p):match("^(.*[\\/])") or "") end local function exists(p) local h = io.open(p, "rb"); if h then h:close(); return true end; return false end local function readfile(p) local h = io.open(p, "rb"); if not h then return nil end; local t = h:read("*a"); h:close(); return t end local function writefile(p, data) local h, err = io.open(p, "wb"); if not h then return false, err end local ok, werr = h:write(data) local cok, cerr = h:close() if not ok or not cok then os.remove(p); return false, werr or cerr end return true end local function install_dir() local d = var("dir", "") if d == "" then d = dirname(GetPluginInfo(SELF, 6) or "") end if d ~= "" and not d:match("[\\/]$") then d = d .. "\\" end return d end -- MUSHclient may be strict about the case of a plugin id (ids are 24 hex characters and some are written with capital letters): calls use the id as the client lists it function H.rid(id) local l = tostring(id):lower() for _, x in ipairs(GetPluginList() or {}) do if x:lower() == l then return x end end return id end function H.is_installed(id) local l = tostring(id):lower() for _, x in ipairs(GetPluginList() or {}) do if x:lower() == l then return true end end return false end function H.sep_in(path) return path:find("\\", 1, true) and "\\" or (path:find("/", 1, true) and "/" or "\\") end function H.join_rel(dir, rel) -- dir ends with a separator; rel uses / return dir .. rel:gsub("/", (H.sep_in(dir))) end function H.dir_ok(path) -- can files be written in this folder? local probe = path .. "pm_probe.tmp" local h = io.open(probe, "wb") if h then h:close(); os.remove(probe); return true end return false end function H.make_dir(path) -- path ends with a separator: create it (and the folders above it) if it is not there; true when it can be written to if H.dir_ok(path) then return true end local l = lfs if not l then local ok, m = pcall(require, "lfs"); if ok then l = m end end if type(l) == "table" and l.mkdir then for i in path:gmatch("()[\\/]") do if i > 1 then pcall(l.mkdir, path:sub(1, i - 1)) end end if H.dir_ok(path) then return true end end if utils and utils.shellexecute then -- the command runs on its own: the caller looks again later local winpath = package.config:sub(1, 1) == "\\" and path:gsub("/", "\\") or path pcall(utils.shellexecute, "cmd", '/C mkdir "' .. winpath .. '"', "", "open", 0) end return H.dir_ok(path) end local function backup_name(path) -- next to the file, the way the other .bak_YYYYMMDD files are: name.xml.bak_20261114 local base = path .. ".bak_" .. os.date("%Y%m%d") if not exists(base) then return base end local n = 2 while n < 500 and exists(base .. "_" .. n) do n = n + 1 end return base .. "_" .. n end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- The plugins that come with the AardMUSHclient package (listed in its Aardwolf.mcl) --------------------------------------------------------------------------- local STOCK = {} for f in ([[aard_requirements.xml aard_text_substitution.xml aard_prompt_fixer.xml aard_chat_echo.xml aard_channels_fiendish.xml aard_soundpack.xml aard_gmcp_handler.xml aard_miniwindow_z_order_monitor.xml aard_layout.xml aard_statmon_gmcp.xml aard_group_monitor_gmcp.xml aard_health_bars_gmcp.xml aard_copy_colour_codes.xml aard_ascii_map.xml aard_repaint_buffer.xml aard_new_connection.xml aard_inventory_serials.xml hyperlink_url2.xml aard_gmcp_mapper.xml aard_package_update_checker.xml aard_help.xml aard_keyboard_lockout.xml aard_splitscreen_scrollback.xml aard_vital_shortcuts.xml aard_theme_controller.xml aard_ingame_help_window.xml automatic_backup.xml]]):gmatch("%S+") do STOCK[f] = true end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Manifest: a JSON file on your server -- { "manifest": 1, "base": "https://host/path/", -- "plugins": [ { "id", "name", "version", "file", "url", "sha256", "purpose", "repo", "extras": [ {"file","url","sha256"} ] } ], -- "outside": [ { "name", "repo", "id" (optional), "note" } ] } --------------------------------------------------------------------------- local OWNER = "Crowley" -- the tab and the group of the plugins that come from the main manifest (and of plugins whose author is OWNER) local DEFAULT_MANIFEST = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AardCrowley/PluginManager/main/manifest.json" -- address of the main manifest. "pm manifest URL" overrides it. local sources = {} -- where plugins are offered from: [1] is the main manifest, the rest are repositories the player added -- { url, kind = "manifest" | "repo" | "file", def = true (main one), data = parsed manifest or nil, err = why the last read failed } local checked_at = tonumber(var("manifest_at", "0")) or 0 local items = {} -- every row (rebuilt by refresh) local shown = {} -- the rows the window drew last: its buttons count in this list local shown_indent = {} -- row -> how far the Store tab indents it (under an owner, under a repository) local listed = {} -- the keys of the rows `pm list` printed last: the numbers in commands and links count in this list local selected, sel_key = nil, nil -- the row picked in the window, and what identifies it (rows are rebuilt on every refresh) local function key_of(it) if it.header == "owner" then return "owner:" .. it.key elseif it.header then return "src:" .. it.src.url end; return it.id or ("name:" .. it.name) end local last_err = nil -- why the last manifest check failed local busy = nil -- a short description of the network job running, if any
local function vernum(v) return tonumber(v) end
-- a file name that may be written into the plugin folder: letters, digits, _ - . ( ) and spaces; no paths, no drive letters, no ":stream" H.RESERVED = {} -- Windows device names: "nul.lua" is the NUL device, whatever the extension for w in ("con prn aux nul com1 com2 com3 com4 com5 com6 com7 com8 com9 lpt1 lpt2 lpt3 lpt4 lpt5 lpt6 lpt7 lpt8 lpt9"):gmatch("%S+") do H.RESERVED[w] = true end local function safe_name(n) return type(n) == "string" and n ~= "" and #n <= 100 and n:match("^[%w_(][%w_%-%. ()]*$") ~= nil and not n:match("[%. ]$") and not H.RESERVED[n:lower():match("^([^.]*)")] end
-- Extra files a plugin needs (its .lua modules, data, sounds ...) may sit in sub-folders of the plugin's own folder: "lua/util.lua", "sounds/hit.wav". do local DENY_EXT = {} for e in ("exe dll bat cmd com scr ps1 vbs vbe js jse wsf wsh msi lnk reg jar cpl hta pif xml mcl"):gmatch("%S+") do DENY_EXT[e] = true end -- programs and plugin/world files are never extras function H.ext_of(name) return (name:lower():match("%.([%w]+)$")) or "" end function H.rel_ok(rel) -- a relative path with / separators: plain names only, at most 4 deep, nothing executable if type(rel) ~= "string" or #rel > 200 then return false end local n, last = 0, nil for seg in (rel .. "/"):gmatch("([^/]*)/") do n = n + 1; last = seg if not safe_name(seg) or seg:lower():match("%.pm_new$") or seg:lower():find(".bak_", 1, true) then return false end end return n >= 1 and n <= 4 and not DENY_EXT[H.ext_of(last)] and not last:lower():match("^plugin_manager_") end -- files that belong to a repository rather than to a plugin: README, LICENSE, git.txt, .gitignore ... (a changelog.lua is code, a changelog.md is not) local DOC_STEMS, DOC_EXT = {}, { [""] = true, txt = true, md = true, markdown = true, rst = true, html = true } for w in ("readme license licence copying notice changelog changes contributing credit credits authors code_of_conduct security history"):gmatch("%S+") do DOC_STEMS[w] = true end function H.denied_file(base) return DENY_EXT[H.ext_of(base)] or false end local ARCHIVE_EXT = {} for e in ("zip rar 7z gz tgz bz2 xz tar iso"):gmatch("%S+") do ARCHIVE_EXT[e] = true end function H.is_archive(base) return ARCHIVE_EXT[H.ext_of(base)] or false end -- an archive in a repository is a download, not a file a plugin needs: the manager cannot unpack it function H.is_standard_file(base) local b = base:lower() if b:sub(1, 1) == "." or b == "git.txt" then return true end local e = H.ext_of(b) if e == "md" or e == "markdown" then return true end return DOC_STEMS[(b:gsub("%..*$", ""))] and DOC_EXT[e] or false end end
local function normalize_manifest(t) if type(t) ~= "table" or type(t.plugins) ~= "table" then return nil, "the manifest has no plugins list" end local out = { base = type(t.base) == "string" and t.base or nil, name = type(t.name) == "string" and t.name or nil, plugins = {}, outside = {} } local seen = {} for _, m in ipairs(t.plugins) do if type(m) == "table" and type(m.id) == "string" and m.id:match("^%x+$") and #m.id == 24 and type(m.name) == "string" and type(m.url) == "string" and (type(m.version) == "string" or type(m.version) == "number") and tostring(m.version):match("^%d+%.?%d*$") and not seen[m.id:lower()] then m.id = m.id:lower(); m.version = tostring(m.version) m.name = (m.name:gsub("%c", " "):sub(1, 80)) -- names end up in dialogs: no line breaks, no essays seen[m.id] = true local file = m.file if type(file) ~= "string" then file = (m.url:match("([^/\\?#]+)$") or "") end if safe_name(file) and file:lower():match("%.xml$") and not file:lower():match("^plugin_manager_") then m.file = file if type(m.sha256) ~= "string" then m.sha256 = nil end for _, k in ipairs({ "purpose", "repo", "changes", "author" }) do if type(m[k]) ~= "string" then m[k] = nil end end if type(m.dir) ~= "string" or not safe_name(m.dir) or m.dir:lower():match("^plugin_manager_") then m.dir = nil end -- the folder a new install goes into (plugins with extra files) local extras, names = {}, { [file:lower()] = true } if type(m.extras) == "table" then for _, x in ipairs(m.extras) do if type(x) == "table" and H.rel_ok(x.file) and type(x.url) == "string" and type(x.sha256) == "string" and #extras < 80 and not names[x.file:lower()] then names[x.file:lower()] = true extras[#extras + 1] = { file = x.file, url = x.url, sha256 = x.sha256 } end end end m.extras = extras out.plugins[#out.plugins + 1] = m end end end if type(t.outside) == "table" then for _, o in ipairs(t.outside) do if type(o) == "table" and type(o.name) == "string" then if type(o.id) ~= "string" then o.id = nil else o.id = o.id:lower() end for _, k in ipairs({ "repo", "note", "author" }) do if type(o[k]) ~= "string" then o[k] = nil end end out.outside[#out.outside + 1] = o end end end return out end
local function parse_manifest(text) if not json_ok then return nil, "the json module is not available" end local ok, t = pcall(json.decode, text) if not ok or type(t) ~= "table" then return nil, "the manifest is not valid JSON" end return normalize_manifest(t) end
local function plugin_dir() return dirname(GetPluginInfo(SELF, 6) or "") end
-- the places plugins are offered from. Anything but the main manifest is a player's choice: a GitHub repository (the manager looks -- for plugin files in it), a manifest (.json) or a single plugin file (.xml) at an https address. local function normalize_source(u) u = trim(u) local o, r, ref, path = u:match("^https://github%.com/([%w_%-%.]+)/([%w_%-%.]+)/blob/([^/]+)/(.+)$") -- a link to a file in a repository: use the raw file if o then return "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/" .. o .. "/" .. r .. "/" .. ref .. "/" .. path end return u end H.OWNER_RESERVED = { orgs = true, users = true, topics = true, features = true, about = true, pricing = true, login = true, settings = true, marketplace = true, explore = true, sponsors = true, collections = true, trending = true, search = true, notifications = true, new = true, issues = true, pulls = true } local function owner_of(u) -- the name in a link to a GitHub user or organization (not to one repository), else nil u = trim(u):gsub("[?#].*$", "") u = u:gsub("/+$", "") local name = u:match("^https://github%.com/orgs/([%w_%-]+)/?[%w_%-/]*$") or u:match("^https://github%.com/([%w_%-]+)$") if name and not H.OWNER_RESERVED[name:lower()] then return name end return nil end local function canon_url(u) -- the same repository written in different ways counts once u = u:lower():gsub("/+$", ""):gsub("%.git$", "") return u end local function kind_of(u) if owner_of(u) then return nil end if u:match("^https://github%.com/[%w_%-%.]+/[%w_%-%.]+/?$") and not H.OWNER_RESERVED[(u:match("^https://github%.com/([%w_%-%.]+)") or ""):lower()] then return "repo" end -- (a repository may be called x.json) local low = u:lower():gsub("[?#].*$", "") local host, tail = u:match("^https://([%w%-%.]+)(.*)$") if not host or (tail ~= "" and not tail:match("^[/?#]")) or tail:find("[^/%w%-%._~%%:!$&'()*+,;=?#]") then return nil end if low:match("%.json$") then return "manifest" end if low:match("%.xml$") then return "file" end if u:match("^https://github%.com/[%w_%-%.]+/[%w_%-%.]+") and not H.OWNER_RESERVED[(u:match("^https://github%.com/([%w_%-%.]+)") or ""):lower()] then return "repo" end return nil end local function repo_parts(url) -- owner, repo, branch (HEAD = the default one), folder inside the repository local o, r, rest = url:match("^https://github%.com/([%w_%-%.]+)/([%w_%-%.]+)(.*)$") if not o then return nil end r = r:gsub("%.git$", "") local ref, sub = "HEAD", "" local b, p = rest:match("^/tree/([^/]+)/?(.*)$") if b then ref = b; sub = (p:gsub("/+$", "")) end return o, r, ref, sub end local function raw_url(o, r, ref, path) return "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/" .. o .. "/" .. r .. "/" .. ref .. "/" .. (path:gsub("[^%w_%-%./]", function(c) return string.format("%%%02X", c:byte()) end)) end local function src_label(src) if src.def then return OWNER end local o, r = src.url:match("^https://github%.com/([%w_%-%.]+)/([%w_%-%.]+)") if not o then o, r = src.url:match("^https://raw%.githubusercontent%.com/([%w_%-%.]+)/([%w_%-%.]+)/") end if o then return o .. "/" .. (r:gsub("%.git$", "")) end return (src.url:gsub("^https://", "")) end local function urlkey(u) -- a short, stable name for a cache file if utils and utils.sha256 then local d = utils.sha256(u) if #d == 32 then d = utils.tohex(d) end return d:lower():sub(1, 16) end local h = 5381 for i = 1, #u do h = (h * 33 + u:byte(i)) % 4294967296 end return string.format("%08x", h) end -- What was read from the sources is kept in ONE file next to the manager, plugin_manager_cache.json ({ "sources": { address: manifest } }), -- so the plugins folder does not fill up with a file per source. local cache = nil local function cache_path() return plugin_dir() .. "plugin_manager_cache.json" end local function cache_save() if not (json_ok and json.encode) then return end if next(cache) == nil then os.remove(cache_path()); return end local ok, text = pcall(json.encode, { cache = 1, sources = cache }) if ok and type(text) == "string" then writefile(cache_path(), text) end end local function migrate_old_cache_files() -- versions before 2.5 wrote plugin_manager_manifest.json and one plugin_manager_src_*.json per source local dir = plugin_dir() local function take(path, url) local text = readfile(path) if text then if url and url ~= "" and not cache[url] then local m = parse_manifest(text); if m then cache[url] = m end end os.remove(path) end end take(dir .. "plugin_manager_manifest.json", var("manifest", DEFAULT_MANIFEST)) for line in (var("sources", "") .. "\n"):gmatch("(.-)\n") do line = trim(line) if line ~= "" then take(dir .. "plugin_manager_src_" .. urlkey(line) .. ".json", line) end end if utils and utils.readdir then -- any that are left (a source that is no longer listed) local ok, list = pcall(utils.readdir, dir .. "plugin_manager_src_*.json") if ok and type(list) == "table" then for name in pairs(list) do if tostring(name):match("^plugin_manager_src_%x+%.json$") then os.remove(dir .. name) end end end end end local function cache_load() if cache then return cache end cache = {} local text = readfile(cache_path()) if text and json_ok then local ok, t = pcall(json.decode, text) if ok and type(t) == "table" and type(t.sources) == "table" then for url, d in pairs(t.sources) do local m = normalize_manifest(d); if m then cache[url] = m end end end end migrate_old_cache_files() cache_save() return cache end local function save_cache(src, m) cache_load()[src.url] = m; cache_save() end local function drop_cache(src) if cache_load()[src.url] then cache[src.url] = nil; cache_save() end end
local function build_sources() -- from the saved settings; what was read from a source that stays is kept local old = {} for _, s in ipairs(sources) do old[s.url] = s end sources = {} local function add(url, kind, def) local o = old[url] local s = { url = url, kind = kind, def = def or nil } if o then s.data, s.err = o.data, o.err else s.data = cache_load()[url] end sources[#sources + 1] = s end local d = normalize_source(var("manifest", DEFAULT_MANIFEST)) -- a link to the file on github.com (".../blob/main/...") is read as the raw file if d ~= "" then add(d, "manifest", true) end for line in (var("sources", "") .. "\n"):gmatch("(.-)\n") do line = trim(line) local k = line ~= "" and line ~= d and kind_of(line) if k then add(line, k) end end end local function save_sources() local t = {} for _, s in ipairs(sources) do if not s.def then t[#t + 1] = s.url end end SetVariable("sources", table.concat(t, "\n")) end local function main_data() return sources[1] and sources[1].def and sources[1].data or nil end
local function src_base(src) -- what a relative address in that source's manifest is relative to local b = src.data and src.data.base if b and b ~= "" then return b end if src.kind == "repo" then local o, r, ref, sub = repo_parts(src.url) if o then return raw_url(o, r, ref, sub ~= "" and (sub .. "/") or "") end end return (src.url:gsub("[?#].*$", ""):gsub("[^/]*$", "")) end local function resolve_url(u, src) if u:match("^https?://") then return u end local base = src and src_base(src) or "" if base ~= "" and not base:match("/$") then base = base .. "/" end return base .. u end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Rows --------------------------------------------------------------------------- local ORDER = { mine = 1, stock = 2, other = 3, store = 4, outside = 5 } local function group_of(it) if it.src and it.src.def then return "mine" end if it.src then return it.loaded and "other" or "store" end -- offered by a repository the player added: never labeled Crowley or Stock local file = (it.file or ""):lower() if STOCK[basename(file)] then return "stock" end if it.loaded and (it.author or ""):lower() == OWNER:lower() then return "mine" end if it.src then return it.loaded and "other" or "store" end return "other" end
local function refresh() items = {} local byid = {} for _, id in ipairs(GetPluginList() or {}) do local lid = id:lower() if not byid[lid] then local it = { id = lid, name = GetPluginInfo(id, 1) or id, ver = GetPluginInfo(id, 19), enabled = GetPluginInfo(id, 17) and true or false, file = GetPluginInfo(id, 6), author = GetPluginInfo(id, 2), purpose = GetPluginInfo(id, 8), loaded = true, self = (lid == SELF:lower()) } byid[lid] = it items[#items + 1] = it end end for _, src in ipairs(sources) do -- the main manifest comes first: a plugin it offers is "Crowley's", whoever else lists it local d = src.data if d then for _, m in ipairs(d.plugins) do local it = byid[m.id] -- a repository cannot take over the update channel of the manager itself, a package plugin, or one by OWNER local guarded = not src.def and it and it.loaded and (it.self or STOCK[basename((it.file or ""):lower())] or (it.author or ""):lower() == OWNER:lower()) if not guarded then if not it then it = { id = m.id, name = m.name, loaded = false } byid[m.id] = it items[#items + 1] = it end if not it.m then it.m, it.src = m, src end end end for _, o in ipairs(d.outside) do local it = o.id and byid[o.id] if it then it.o = it.o or o else items[#items + 1] = { name = o.name, loaded = false, o = o, outside = true } end end end end for _, it in ipairs(items) do it.group = it.outside and "other" or group_of(it) -- link-only entries (the manifest's "outside" list) sit under Other with the rest if it.m and it.group ~= "stock" and not (it.loaded and STOCK[basename((it.file or ""):lower())]) then -- stock plugins are never checked: they are updated with the AardMUSHclient package local mv, iv = vernum(it.m.version), vernum(it.ver) it.update = (it.loaded and mv and iv and mv > iv) and true or false it.ahead = (it.loaded and mv and iv and iv > mv) and true or false it.changed = (it.loaded and not it.update and not it.ahead and H.differs(it)) and true or false -- same version, but not the file the source offers end end table.sort(items, function(a, b) if a.group ~= b.group then return ORDER[a.group] < ORDER[b.group] end return a.name:lower() < b.name:lower() end) selected = nil if sel_key then for _, it in ipairs(items) do if key_of(it) == sel_key then selected = it end end end end
local function live(key) -- the current row for a key (rows are rebuilt on every refresh) for _, it in ipairs(items) do if key_of(it) == key then return it end end end
local function changed_count() local n = 0 for _, it in ipairs(items) do if it.changed then n = n + 1 end end return n end
local function updates_count() -- newer versions and changed files: what Update all installs local n = 0 for _, it in ipairs(items) do if it.update or it.changed then n = n + 1 end end return n end
local FILTERS = { all = true, mine = true, crowley = true, stock = true, other = true, store = true, links = true, updates = true } local function filter_rows(which) if which == "crowley" then which = "mine" end local out = {} for _, it in ipairs(items) do if which == "all" or which == it.group or (which == "updates" and it.update) or (which == "links" and it.outside) or (which == "store" and it.src and not it.src.def) then out[#out + 1] = it end end return out end
-- the owner a source belongs to: the GitHub user or organization, else the host it is served from local function owner_key(src) local o = src.url:match("^https://github%.com/([%w_%-]+)/") or src.url:match("^https://raw%.githubusercontent%.com/([%w_%-]+)/") return o or src.url:match("^https://([^/]+)") or "other" end local function repo_part(src, owner) -- a source's name without the owner in front of it local label = src_label(src) local pre = owner:lower() .. "/" if label:lower():sub(1, #pre) == pre then return label:sub(#pre + 1) end return label end -- what the window lists. The Store tab is two accordions: one header per owner (only the picked owner is open), and inside an owner that has several -- repositories one header per repository (only the picked one is open). ")"); return end local done = false local function result(ok, v) if done then return end done = true local cok, cerr = pcall(cb, ok, v) if not cok then busy = nil; say("Internal error: " .. tostring(cerr)) end end local ok, err = pcall(async.doAsyncRemoteRequest, url, function(retval, page, status) if type(status) ~= "number" then result(false, tostring(status or retval or "no answer")) elseif status ~= 200 then result(false, "HTTP " .. status) elseif type(page) ~= "string" then result(false, "no answer") elseif #page > 6000000 then result(false, "the answer is too large (" .. #page .. " bytes)") else result(true, page) end end, nil, 30, function() result(false, "timed out") end) if not ok then result(false, tostring(err)) end end
-- the checksum is required: no checksum, or no way to compute one, means no install local function sha_hex(body) local d = utils.sha256(body) if #d == 32 then d = utils.tohex(d) end -- the client answers with the 32 raw bytes return d:lower() end local function sha_ok(body, want) if type(want) ~= "string" or want == "" then return false, "the manifest has no checksum for it" end if not (utils and utils.sha256) then return false, "this client cannot compute the checksum" end if sha_hex(body) == want:lower() then return true end return false, "checksum does not match (the file is not the one the manifest describes)" end
-- the installed file against the checksum the source lists: a difference at the same version means the author changed the file without raising the version. -- Only local files are read (nothing is downloaded). Line endings are ignored, since a copy saved by another tool may have them changed. function H.differs(it) local want = it.m and it.m.sha256 if type(want) ~= "string" or want == "" or not it.file or not (utils and utils.sha256) then return false end local body = readfile(it.file) if not body or body == "" then return false end want = want:lower() local lf = body:gsub("\r\n", "\n") local crlf = lf:gsub("\n", "\r\n") for _, b in ipairs({ body, lf, crlf }) do local ok, h = pcall(sha_hex, b) if ok and h == want then return false end end return true end
-- is this text the plugin the manifest entry says it is, complete, and does its script compile? local function plugin_attrs(body) -- the attributes of the <plugin ...> tag, read one by one so a ">" inside a value does not end the tag early local _, e = body:sub(1, 12000):find("<plugin%s") if not e then return nil end local attrs, pos = {}, e + 1 while true do local s0, f, k, v = body:find('^%s*([%w_%-]+)%s*=%s*"([^"]*)"', pos) if not s0 then break end attrs[k] = v; pos = f + 1 end return attrs end
local function plugin_text_ok(body, m) if not body:find("<muclient", 1, true) or not body:find("<plugin", 1, true) then return false, "that is not a plugin file" end if not body:match("</muclient>%s*$") then return false, "the plugin file is cut off (no closing tag)" end local attrs = plugin_attrs(body) or {} local id = attrs.id if not id or id:lower() ~= m.id then return false, "the file's plugin id is not " .. m.id end local ver = attrs.version if not ver or tonumber(ver) ~= tonumber(m.version) then return false, "the file is version " .. tostring(ver) .. " but the manifest says " .. tostring(m.version) end local code -- the first script block (plain searches: a hostile file cannot make a pattern run for ages) local s1, e1 = body:find("<script>", 1, true) if s1 then -- the end marker is written in two parts below: this file is itself inside a CDATA block local _, e2 = body:find("^%s*<!%[CDATA%[", e1 + 1) if e2 then local s3 = body:find("]" .. "]>", e2 + 1, true); if s3 then code = body:sub(e2 + 1, s3 - 1) end end end if code then local f, err = loadstring(code, "=plugin") if not f then return false, "its script does not compile: " .. tostring(err) end end return true end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Reading the sources --------------------------------------------------------------------------- local function fetch_manifest_source(src, cb) -- a manifest at an address http_get(src.url, function(ok, body) if not ok then cb(false, body); return end local m, why = parse_manifest(body) if not m then cb(false, why); return end src.data = m save_cache(src, m) cb(true) end) end

(extra and (" (" .. extra .. ")") or "") .. "/manifest.json") or "manifest.json") http_get(murl, function(ok, body) if ok then local m = parse_manifest(body) if m then if not m.base then m.base = raw_url(o, r, ref, sub ~= "" and (sub .. "/") or "") end src.data = m save_cache(src, m) cb(true); return end end next_step() end) end local function scan() src.skipnote = nil http_get("https://api.github.com/repos/" .. o .. "/" .. r .. "/git/trees/" .. ref .. "?recursive=1", function(ok, body) if not ok then cb(false, "could not list the repository (" .. tostring(body) .. ")"); return end local dok, tree = pcall(json.decode, body) if not dok or type(tree) ~= "table" or type(tree.tree) ~= "table" then cb(false, "the repository listing could not be read"); return end local blobs, xml, seen_all = {}, {}, 0 if tree.truncated == true then src.note = "the repository is too big to list completely" end local prefix = sub ~= "" and (sub .. "/") or "" for _, e in ipairs(tree.tree) do local path = e.path if type(path) == "string" and e.type == "blob" and path:sub(1, #prefix) == prefix and not path:find("^%.") and not path:find("/%.") then local dir, file = path:match("^(.*)/([^/]+)$") if not dir then dir, file = "", path end local size = tonumber(e.size) or 0 blobs[#blobs + 1] = { path = path, dir = dir, file = file, size = size } if file:lower():match("%.xml$") and safe_name(file) and size <= MAX_SIZE then seen_all = seen_all + 1 if #xml < MAX_SCAN then xml[#xml + 1] = { path = path, dir = dir, file = file } end end end end local entries, skipped, i = {}, 0, 0 -- pass 2: the files a plugin needs. "/" then if not best or #pd > #best then best = pd end end end return best end local jobs = {} -- { entry, path, rel } for _, e in ipairs(entries) do local n = 0 for _, bl in ipairs(blobs) do local rel if e.cdir == "" then rel = bl.path elseif bl.path:sub(1, #e.cdir + 1) == e.cdir .. "/" then rel = bl.path:sub(#e.cdir + 2) end if rel and bl.path ~= e.cpath and owner_dir(bl.dir) == e.cdir and not H.is_standard_file(bl.file) and not H.denied_file(bl.file) and not H.is_archive(bl.file) then -- a file that belongs to the plugin but cannot be installed makes the plugin incomplete: it is left out of the list rather than offered broken if bl.size > MAX_SIZE then e.incomplete = e.incomplete or (rel .. " is too large") elseif not H.rel_ok(rel) then e.incomplete = e.incomplete or (rel .. " has a name or a place the manager does not use") elseif n >= 80 then e.incomplete = e.incomplete or "it has more than 80 files" else n = n + 1; jobs[#jobs + 1] = { e = e, path = bl.path, rel = rel } end end end end local k = 0 local function nextjob() k = k + 1 local j = jobs[k] if not j then local complete = {} for _, e in ipairs(entries) do if e.failed or e.incomplete then skipped = skipped + 1 -- a file it needs could not be fetched or installed: not listed (it would install broken) src.skipnote = src.skipnote or (e.name .. ": " .. (e.incomplete or "a file it needs could not be downloaded")) else local stem = e.file:gsub("%.[Xx][Mm][Ll]$", "") if #e.extras > 0 and safe_name(stem) then e.dir = stem end -- a plugin with files of its own gets a folder of its own e.cdir, e.cpath = nil, nil complete[#complete + 1] = e end end finish(complete, o .. "/" .. r, skipped, (seen_all > 0 and (seen_all .. " .xml file(s) looked at")) or "no .xml files") return end http_get(raw_url(o, r, ref, j.path), function(cok, cbody) if cok then j.e.extras[#j.e.extras + 1] = { file = j.rel, url = raw_url(o, r, ref, j.path), sha256 = sha_hex(cbody) } else j.e.failed = (j.e.failed or 0) + 1 end nextjob() end) end nextjob() end local function nextfile() i = i + 1 local c = xml[i] if not c then dependencies(); return end http_get(raw_url(o, r, ref, c.path), function(fok, fbody) local meta = fok and plugin_meta(fbody) local pok = meta and plugin_text_ok(fbody, meta) if not (meta and pok) then if fok and meta then skipped = skipped + 1 end; nextfile(); return end entries[#entries + 1] = { id = meta.id, name = meta.name, version = meta.version, file = c.file, url = raw_url(o, r, ref, c.path), sha256 = sha_hex(fbody), purpose = meta.purpose, author = meta.author, repo = "https://github.com/" .. o .. "/" .. r, extras = {}, cdir = c.dir, cpath = c.path } nextfile() end) end nextfile() end) end manifest_try(scan) end
local function fetch_sources(cb, only) -- reads the sources one after the other (every one, or just the list "only"); cb(any_ok, first_problem) if #sources == 0 then cb(false, "no manifest address is set: pm manifest https://... (or add a repository: pm source add URL)"); return end local list = only or sources if #list == 0 then cb(false, "there is nothing to check here"); return end local i, anyok, first = 0, false, nil local defok = false -- the time of the last check only moves when the main manifest itself was read local function nextsrc() i = i + 1 local src = list[i] if not src then if defok then checked_at = os.time(); SetVariable("manifest_at", tostring(checked_at)) end refresh() cb(anyok, first); return end local function done(ok, why) src.err = (not ok) and tostring(why) or nil if ok then anyok = true; if src.def then defok = true end elseif not first then first = (#list > 1 and (src_label(src) .. ": ") or "") .. tostring(why) end nextsrc() end local f = src.kind == "manifest" and fetch_manifest_source or detect_repo local ok, err = pcall(f, src, done) if not ok then done(false, "internal error: " .. tostring(err)) end end nextsrc() end
local function finish_job() busy = nil; after_change() end
-- download every file of one entry, check them, then swap them in (old files kept as name.bak_DATE); cb(ok, reason) -- Either all files are swapped in or none: a failure part-way puts the already swapped ones back. local function apply_entry(it, target, cb) local m = it.m local files = { { url = resolve_url(m.url, it.src), path = target, sha = m.sha256, main = true } } local used = { [target:lower()] = true } for _, x in ipairs(m.extras or {}) do local path = H.join_rel(dirname(target), x.file) if used[path:lower()] then cb(false, "the manifest lists " .. x.file .. " twice"); return end used[path:lower()] = true files[#files + 1] = { url = resolve_url(x.url, it.src), path = path, sha = x.sha256 } end local got = {} local dirs, dirlist = {}, {} -- the folders the files go into: made now, looked at again when the files are ready for _, f in ipairs(files) do local d = dirname(f.path) if d ~= "" and not dirs[d:lower()] then dirs[d:lower()] = true; dirlist[#dirlist + 1] = d end end for _, d in ipairs(dirlist) do H.make_dir(d) end local function cleanup(temps) for _, t in ipairs(temps) do os.remove(t) end end local function swap() for _, d in ipairs(dirlist) do if not H.dir_ok(d) then cb(false, "the folder " .. d .. " does not exist and could not be created: make it by hand and try again"); return end end local temps = {} for k, g in ipairs(files) do local tmp = g.path .. ".pm_new" local ok, err = writefile(tmp, got[k]) if not ok then cleanup(temps); os.remove(tmp); cb(false, "could not write " .. tmp .. ": " .. tostring(err)); return end temps[#temps + 1] = tmp end local done = {} -- { path, bak } for every file already swapped local function undo_done() for j = #done, 1, -1 do os.remove(done[j].path) if done[j].bak ~= "" then os.rename(done[j].bak, done[j].path) end end end for k, g in ipairs(files) do local bak = "" if exists(g.path) then bak = backup_name(g.path) local ok, err = os.rename(g.path, bak) if not ok then undo_done(); cleanup(temps); cb(false, "could not move " .. g.path .. " aside: " .. tostring(err)); return end end local ok, err = os.rename(temps[k], g.path) if not ok then if bak ~= "" then os.rename(bak, g.path) end undo_done(); cleanup(temps); cb(false, "could not put " .. g.path .. " in place: " .. tostring(err)); return end done[#done + 1] = { path = g.path, bak = bak } end local record, any = {}, false for _, d in ipairs(done) do record[#record + 1] = d.path .. "\t" .. d.bak; if d.bak ~= "" then any = true end end SetVariable("undo_" .. it.id, any and table.concat(record, "\n") or "") local mine = {} for k = 2, #files do mine[#mine + 1] = files[k].path end SetVariable("files_" .. it.id, table.concat(mine, "\n")) cb(true) end local function fetch(i) local f = files[i] if not f then swap(); return end http_get(f.url, function(ok, body) if not ok then cb(false, "download of " .. basename(f.path) .. " failed: " .. body); return end local sok, swhy = sha_ok(body, f.sha) if not sok then cb(false, basename(f.path) .. ": " .. swhy); return end if f.main then local pok, pwhy = plugin_text_ok(body, m) if not pok then cb(false, basename(f.path) .. ": " .. pwhy); return end end got[i] = body fetch(i + 1) end) end fetch(1) end
-- put the files the last update replaced back; returns the main file's path, or nil and why. The record is only cleared when everything went back. local function undo_files(it) local rec = var("undo_" .. it.id, "") if rec == "" then return nil, "nothing to undo for " .. it.name .. " (no update by the manager is on record)" end local list = {} for line in (rec .. "\n"):gmatch("(.-)\n") do local path, bak = line:match("^(.-)\t(.*)$") if path then list[#list + 1] = { path = path, bak = bak } end end for _, e in ipairs(list) do if e.bak ~= "" and not exists(e.bak) then return nil, "the backup file is missing: " .. e.bak end end local function keep_from(i) -- what is left to do goes back on record, so a second try carries on local t = {} for j = i, #list do t[#t + 1] = list[j].path .. "\t" .. list[j].bak end SetVariable("undo_" .. it.id, table.concat(t, "\n")) end for i, e in ipairs(list) do local aside if exists(e.path) then aside = backup_name(e.path) local ok, err = os.rename(e.path, aside) if not ok then keep_from(i); return nil, "could not move " .. e.path .. " aside: " .. tostring(err) end end if e.bak ~= "" then local ok, err = os.rename(e.bak, e.path) if not ok then if aside then os.rename(aside, e.path) end; keep_from(i); return nil, "could not restore " .. e.path .. ": " .. tostring(err) end end end SetVariable("undo_" .. it.id, "") return list[1] and list[1].path end
-- extra files the manager put in place for a plugin are remembered (files_<id>), so an update may replace them but never another plugin's file of the same name function H.owned(id, path) return ("\n" .. var("files_" .. id, ""):lower() .. "\n"):find("\n" .. path:lower() .. "\n", 1, true) ~= nil end function H.extras_conflict(id, target, m, only_shared) -- the first extra file that would replace somebody else's file, or nil local d = dirname(target) if only_shared then -- an existing plugin in a folder of its own may replace its own files; one in the shared plugins folder may not replace others' local shared = d:lower() == (GetInfo(60) or ""):lower() or d:lower() == install_dir():lower() if not shared then return nil end end for _, x in ipairs(m.extras or {}) do local path = H.join_rel(d, x.file) if exists(path) and not H.owned(id, path) then return x.file, path end end end
local function new_target(m) -- where a new install goes: a folder of its own when the manifest names one (plugins with extra files), else the install folder local d = install_dir() if m.dir then d = d .. m.dir .. H.sep_in(d) end return d .. m.file end
local function do_update(it, cb) -- cb(ok, text) local m = it.m if not m then cb(false, it.name .. " is not in the manifest."); return end local installed = it.loaded local target = installed and it.file or new_target(m) if not target or target == "" then cb(false, "no file path known for " .. it.name); return end if installed then local cf = H.extras_conflict(it.id, target, m, true) if cf then cb(false, it.name .. ": a file named " .. cf .. " is already in " .. dirname(target) .. " and was not put there by this plugin (it could be another plugin's), so it is not replaced. Move the plugin into a folder of its own, or remove that file."); return end end if not installed then -- a new install never replaces a file that is already there (it could be another plugin's) if exists(target) then cb(false, it.name .. ": a file named " .. basename(target) .. " is already in " .. dirname(target) .. " (not this plugin, or not loaded). Remove or rename it first."); return end for _, x in ipairs(m.extras or {}) do if exists(H.join_rel(dirname(target), x.file)) then cb(false, it.name .. ": a file named " .. x.file .. " is already in " .. dirname(target) .. ". Remove or rename it first."); return end end end say((installed and "Updating " or "Installing ") .. it.name .. "...") apply_entry(it, target, function(ok, why) if not ok then cb(false, it.name .. ": " .. why); return end if it.self then say("Updated the manager's file (the old one is kept as " .. basename(target) .. ".bak_*); reloading it...") reload_self(it.id) cb(true, "updated"); return end local rc if installed then rc = reload_keeping_state(it) else rc = LoadPlugin(target) end if rc ~= 0 or not H.is_installed(it.id) then local why2 = rc ~= 0 and rc_text(rc) or "it did not stay loaded" if installed then local main, uwhy = undo_files(it) local rc2 = main and LoadPlugin(main) if main and rc2 == 0 and H.is_installed(it.id) then if it.enabled == false then EnablePlugin(H.rid(it.id), false) end cb(false, it.name .. " did not load after the update (" .. why2 .. "); the previous version was put back.") else cb(false, it.name .. " did not load after the update (" .. why2 .. ") and the previous version could not be put back: " .. tostring(uwhy or (main and rc_text(rc2)) or "") .. " Files: " .. target .. " and its .bak_ copy.") end else cb(false, it.name .. " was downloaded to " .. target .. " but did not load: " .. why2) end return end cb(true, (installed and "Updated " or "Installed ") .. it.name .. " to v" .. tostring(m.version) .. (installed and " (pm rollback " .. it.name .. " undoes it)" or " (pm save keeps it loaded next time)")) end) end
local function run_jobs(list, verb) -- one at a time; the manager itself goes last, because its reload ends the run if busy then say("Wait for the " .. busy .. " to finish."); return end table.sort(list, function(a, b) return (a.self and 1 or 0) < (b.self and 1 or 0) end) local i, okc, failc = 0, 0, 0 busy = verb local function nextjob() i = i + 1 local it = list[i] if not it then say(verb .. " finished: " .. okc .. " done" .. (failc > 0 and (", " .. failc .. " failed") or "") .. ".") finish_job(); return end local function done(ok, text) if ok then okc = okc + 1 else failc = failc + 1 end say(text) DoAfterSpecial(0.2, "pm_next_job()", 12) end local pok, perr = pcall(do_update, it, done) if not pok then done(false, it.name .. ": internal error: " .. tostring(perr)) end end _G.pm_next_job = nextjob nextjob() end
local function act_check(quiet, finished, only) -- finished(ok, problem) is called when the check is over. only: a list of sources (no list: all of them) if busy then if not quiet then say("Wait for the " .. busy .. " to finish.") end; return end busy = "check" fetch_sources(function(ok, why) busy = nil last_err = why and tostring(why) or nil if finished then pcall(finished, ok, why) end if not ok then if not quiet then say("Could not read the manifest: " .. tostring(why)) end after_change(); return end if why and not quiet then say("Not everything could be read: " .. tostring(why)) end local c = changed_count() local n = updates_count() - c if n > 0 then say(n .. " update" .. (n == 1 and "" or "s") .. " available: pm list updates (pm update all installs them)") end if c > 0 then say(c .. " plugin" .. (c == 1 and " has" or "s have") .. " changes detected: the file offered is not the one you have, though the version is the same (pm update NAME or pm update all gets them)") end if n == 0 and c == 0 and not quiet then say(only and "Everything that was checked is up to date." or "Everything listed is up to date.") end after_change() end, only) end
function pm_autocheck() if var("auto", "on") ~= "on" or #sources == 0 then return end if os.time() - checked_at < 20 * 3600 then return end local main = {} -- the daily check reads only the main manifest; the repositories are checked by hand (they are slower and GitHub limits the requests) for _, s0 in ipairs(sources) do if s0.def then main[#main + 1] = s0 end end if #main > 0 then act_check(true, nil, main) end end
-- a yes/no question in a dialog (the window's buttons ask; typed commands do not, you just typed them). Without dialogs the answer is yes. local function confirm(msg) if not (utils and utils.msgbox) then say("This client cannot show a question dialog; nothing was done. (Typed commands do not ask.)"); return false end local ok, r = pcall(utils.msgbox, msg, "Plugin Manager", "yesno", "?", 2) return ok and tostring(r):lower() == "yes" end
-- an installed plugin an offered one could be a fork of: the same id, the same file name, or a very alike name local function norm_name(n) return (tostring(n or ""):lower():gsub("[^%w]", "")) end local function similar_loaded(it) if not (it.m and it.src and not it.src.def) then return nil end if it.loaded then return it end -- the same plugin id is installed local nn, ff = norm_name(it.m.name), (it.m.file or ""):lower() local best, rank = nil, 0 for _, o in ipairs(items) do if o.loaded and o ~= it and not o.header then local on = norm_name(o.name) local r = 0 if ff ~= "" and basename((o.file or ""):lower()) == ff then r = 3 elseif on ~= "" and on == nn then r = 2 elseif #nn >= 5 and #on >= 5 and (on:find(nn, 1, true) or nn:find(on, 1, true)) then r = 1 end if r > rank then best, rank = o, r end end end return best end
-- force install: the plugin from a repository replaces the look-alike that is installed. The current plugin is backed up first (name.xml.bak_DATE), -- taken out of MUSHclient, and the repository's version put in; if that does not load, the old one is put back. local function act_force(it) if busy then say("Wait for the " .. busy .. " to finish."); return end local m = it.m if not (m and it.src and not it.src.def) then say("Force install is for a plugin a repository offers (Store tab)."); return end local old = similar_loaded(it) if not old then say("Nothing installed looks like " .. it.name .. ". Use pm install instead."); return end if old.self then say("The manager does not replace itself this way (pm update does it)."); return end local oldfile = old.file if not oldfile or oldfile == "" then say("No file is known for " .. old.name .. ", so it cannot be backed up. Nothing was changed."); return end local same_file = basename(oldfile):lower() == m.file:lower() local target = same_file and oldfile or new_target(m) if not same_file and exists(target) then say("A file named " .. m.file .. " is already in " .. dirname(target) .. ". Remove or rename it first. Nothing was changed."); return end local cf = H.extras_conflict(m.id, target, m, same_file) if cf then say("A file named " .. cf .. " is already in " .. dirname(target) .. " and was not put there by this plugin, so it is not replaced. Nothing was changed."); return end local backup if not same_file then -- the update machinery only backs up the file it replaces: here a copy of the old plugin is made first local body = readfile(oldfile) if not body then say("Could not read " .. oldfile .. " to back it up. Nothing was changed."); return end backup = backup_name(oldfile) local ok, err = writefile(backup, body) if not ok then say("Could not write the backup " .. backup .. ": " .. tostring(err) .. ". Nothing was changed."); return end end busy = "force install" say("Force installing " .. it.name .. " v" .. tostring(m.version) .. " over " .. old.name .. "...") local fake = { id = m.id, name = it.name, m = m, src = it.src } apply_entry(fake, target, function(ok, why) if not ok then if backup then os.remove(backup) end busy = nil; say("Force install failed: " .. tostring(why) .. " (nothing was changed)"); after_change(); return end local was_enabled = old.enabled UnloadPlugin(H.rid(old.id)) local rc = LoadPlugin(target) if rc ~= 0 or not H.is_installed(m.id) then local why2 = rc ~= 0 and rc_text(rc) or "it did not stay loaded" if H.is_installed(m.id) then UnloadPlugin(H.rid(m.id)) end local restored = undo_files(fake) -- the old file comes back (same file name) ... if not restored and not same_file and exists(target) then os.rename(target, backup_name(target)) end -- ... or the new file is set aside (never deleted) local rc2 = LoadPlugin(oldfile) if rc2 == 0 and was_enabled == false then EnablePlugin(H.rid(old.id), false) end busy = nil say("The repository's " .. it.name .. " did not load (" .. why2 .. "). " .. (rc2 == 0 and ("The previous plugin, " .. old.name .. ", was put back.") or ("Could not load the previous plugin again: " .. rc_text(rc2) .. " Its file: " .. oldfile .. (backup and (" Backup: " .. backup) or "")))) after_change(); return end local kept = backup if not kept then local rec = var("undo_" .. m.id, ""); kept = rec:match("\t(.-)\n") or rec:match("\t(.-)$") end busy = nil say("Installed " .. it.name .. " v" .. tostring(m.version) .. " in place of " .. old.name .. ". The previous plugin file is kept as " .. tostring(kept) .. ". (pm save keeps this next time" .. (same_file and ("; pm rollback " .. it.name .. " puts the old file back") or "") .. ")") after_change() end) end
-- uninstall: take the plugin out of MUSHclient and nothing else. Its file, its saved state and its other files are never touched. local function act_remove(it) if not it.loaded then say(it.name .. " is not loaded."); return end if it.self then say("The manager does not remove itself."); return end local file = it.file if not file or file == "" then say("No file is known for " .. it.name .. ", so it is not removed."); return end local rc = UnloadPlugin(H.rid(it.id)) if rc ~= 0 then say("Could not unload " .. it.name .. ": " .. rc_text(rc)); return end say("Removed " .. it.name .. " from MUSHclient. Its file (" .. file .. ") and its saved data are untouched. (pm save, so it stays out next time; pm load adds it back)") after_change() end
-- add a plugin file the player downloaded by hand: check it, copy it into the plugins folder (unless it is already inside), load it local function same_dir_file(path, name) return dirname(path) .. name end local function act_add(path) path = trim(path):gsub('^"(.*)"$', "%1") if path == "" then say("pm add FILE (the path of a plugin .xml file you downloaded)"); return end if not path:match("^%a:[\\/]") and not path:match("^[\\/]") then path = (GetInfo(60) or "") .. path end local body = readfile(path) if not body then say("Cannot read " .. path); return end local meta = plugin_meta(body) if not meta then say(basename(path) .. " does not look like a MUSHclient plugin file (no <plugin> tag with a 24 character id, a name and a numeric version)."); return end local pok, pwhy = plugin_text_ok(body, meta) if not pok then say(basename(path) .. ": " .. pwhy); return end if H.is_installed(meta.id) then say(meta.name .. " is already loaded (" .. tostring(GetPluginInfo(H.rid(meta.id), 6)) .. "). To replace it, remove it first, then add the file again.") return end local root = (GetInfo(60) or ""):lower():gsub("/", "\\") local inside = root ~= "" and path:lower():gsub("/", "\\"):sub(1, #root) == root local target, made, aside = path, {}, {} if not inside then if not safe_name(basename(path)) then say("The file name " .. basename(path) .. " is not usable (letters, digits, _ - . ( ) and spaces): rename it first."); return end target = install_dir() .. basename(path) local function put(to, text) if exists(to) then local bak = backup_name(to) local ok, err = os.rename(to, bak) if not ok then return false, "could not move " .. to .. " aside: " .. tostring(err) end aside[#aside + 1] = { to = to, bak = bak } end local ok, err = writefile(to, text) if not ok then return false, "could not write " .. to .. ": " .. tostring(err) end made[#made + 1] = to return true end local ok, err = put(target, body) if not ok then for _, f in ipairs(made) do os.remove(f) end for j = #aside, 1, -1 do os.rename(aside[j].bak, aside[j].to) end say(err); return end local words = {} -- .lua files next to it that it names: copied along, never over an existing file for w in body:gmatch('["\']([%w_%-%.]+)["\']') do words[w] = true end for w in body:gmatch("([%w_%-]+)%.lua") do words[w] = true end local n = 0 for w in pairs(words) do local f = w:gsub("%.lua$", "") .. ".lua" if n < 6 and safe_name(f) and exists(same_dir_file(path, f)) and not exists(install_dir() .. f) then local text = readfile(same_dir_file(path, f)) if text then if put(install_dir() .. f, text) then n = n + 1 end end end end end local rc = LoadPlugin(target) if rc ~= 0 or not H.is_installed(meta.id) then for _, f in ipairs(made) do os.remove(f) end for j = #aside, 1, -1 do os.rename(aside[j].bak, aside[j].to) end say("Could not load " .. basename(path) .. ": " .. (rc ~= 0 and rc_text(rc) or "it did not stay loaded") .. (#made > 0 and " (the copy was taken back out)" or "")) return end say("Added " .. meta.name .. " v" .. meta.version .. (inside and "" or (" (copied to " .. target .. ")")) .. ". (pm save keeps it loaded next time)") after_change() end
-- a GitHub user or organization: list its repositories, then either let the player pick the ones to add, or look through all of them for plugins local open_owner_window -- the checklist window (defined with the other windows); nil when themed windows are not available local function fetch_owner_repos(owner, cb) -- cb(ok, repos | reason) local all, page = {}, 0 local function nextpage() page = page + 1 http_get("https://api.github.com/users/" .. owner .. "/repos?per_page=100&page=" .. page, function(ok, body) if not ok then local why = tostring(body) if why == "HTTP 404" then why = "GitHub has no user or organization called " .. owner elseif why == "HTTP 403" or why == "HTTP 429" then why = "GitHub says too many requests (without an account it allows 60 an hour): try again later" end if page > 1 and #all > 0 then table.sort(all, function(a, b) return a.name:lower() < b.name:lower() end); cb(true, all, "only the first " .. #all .. " repositories could be listed (" .. why .. ")") else cb(false, why) end return end local dok, t = pcall(json.decode, body) if not dok or type(t) ~= "table" then cb(false, "the list of repositories could not be read"); return end for _, r in ipairs(t) do if type(r) == "table" and type(r.name) == "string" and r.name:match("^[%w_%-%.]+$") then all[#all + 1] = { name = r.name, url = "https://github.com/" .. owner .. "/" .. r.name, desc = type(r.description) == "string" and r.description or "", fork = r.fork == true, archived = r.archived == true, empty = (tonumber(r.size) or 1) == 0, pushed = type(r.pushed_at) == "string" and r.pushed_at:sub(1, 10) or "" } end end if #t >= 100 and page < 5 then nextpage() else table.sort(all, function(a, b) return a.name:lower() < b.name:lower() end); cb(true, all) end end) end nextpage() end
local function add_repo_sources(urls) -- put these repositories on the source list (already listed ones are skipped); returns how many were new local have, t, n, newset = {}, {}, 0, {} for _, s0 in ipairs(sources) do have[canon_url(s0.url)] = true; if not s0.def then t[#t + 1] = s0.url end end for _, u in ipairs(urls) do if not have[canon_url(u)] then have[canon_url(u)] = true; newset[canon_url(u)] = true; t[#t + 1] = u; n = n + 1 end end SetVariable("sources", table.concat(t, "\n")) build_sources() refresh() -- the rows must point at the new source tables, or the Store tab shows nothing until the next check ends local fresh = {} for _, s0 in ipairs(sources) do if newset[canon_url(s0.url)] then fresh[#fresh + 1] = s0 end end -- only the new ones are read return n, fresh end
local SCAN_MAX = 50 -- repositories looked through in one go (the tree request counts against GitHub's 60 an hour) local function scannable(repos) -- forks, archived and empty repositories are skipped, and so are the ones already listed (a second run goes on where the first stopped) local list, have = {}, {} for _, s0 in ipairs(sources) do have[canon_url(s0.url)] = true end for _, r in ipairs(repos) do if not (r.fork or r.archived or r.empty or have[canon_url(r.url)]) then list[#list + 1] = r end end return list end local function scan_repos(owner, list, progress, done) -- look at each repository for plugin files; the ones that have some become sources. done(found_count, problem) if busy then say("Wait for the " .. busy .. " to finish."); return end busy = "repository scan" local capped = #list > SCAN_MAX local i, found, rate = 0, {}, false local function finish() busy = nil local urls = {} for _, f in ipairs(found) do urls[#urls + 1] = f.url end local n = add_repo_sources(urls) local problem = rate and "GitHub's request limit was reached (60 an hour without an account): the rest were not looked at. Try again later." or (capped and ("Only " .. SCAN_MAX .. " repositories were looked at this time; run it again to go on with the rest.") or nil) refresh() done(#found, problem, n) after_change() end local function nxt() i = i + 1 local r = list[i] if not r or rate or i > SCAN_MAX then finish(); return end if progress then progress("Looking at " .. i .. "/" .. math.min(#list, SCAN_MAX) .. ": " .. r.name) end local src = { url = r.url, kind = "repo" } local ok, err = pcall(detect_repo, src, function(sok, why) if sok and src.data and #src.data.plugins > 0 then found[#found + 1] = { url = r.url, name = r.name, count = #src.data.plugins } elseif sok then drop_cache(src) -- no plugins in it: it is not kept in the cache elseif not sok and (tostring(why):find("HTTP 403", 1, true) or tostring(why):find("HTTP 429", 1, true)) then rate = true end nxt() end) if not ok then nxt() end end nxt() end
local function act_add_owner(owner, scan_now) if busy then say("Wait for the " .. busy .. " to finish."); return end busy = "repository list" say("Reading the repositories of " .. owner .. "...") fetch_owner_repos(owner, function(ok, repos, partial) busy = nil if not ok then say("Could not read the repositories of " .. owner .. ": " .. tostring(repos)); return end if #repos == 0 then say(owner .. " has no public repositories."); return end if scan_now then local list = scannable(repos) if #list == 0 then say("Nothing to look at: the repositories of " .. owner .. " are forks, archived, empty or already listed."); return end say("Looking through " .. math.min(#list, SCAN_MAX) .. " repositories of " .. owner .. " for plugins...") scan_repos(owner, list, nil, function(n, problem) say("Found plugins in " .. n .. " repositor" .. (n == 1 and "y" or "ies") .. " of " .. owner .. (n > 0 and ("; they are on the Store tab (pm source lists them).") or ".")) if problem then say(problem) end end) return end if open_owner_window and open_owner_window(owner, repos, partial) then return end if partial then say("Note: " .. partial) end say(owner .. " has " .. #repos .. " repositories:") for _, r in ipairs(repos) do ColourNote("gray", "", " ", "white", "", r.name, "gray", "", (r.fork and " fork" or "") .. (r.archived and " archived" or "") .. (r.desc ~= "" and (" " .. r.desc:sub(1, 70)) or "")) end say("Add one with pm source add https://github.com/" .. owner ..
